summary: I read the full revised docs/design/defaults-loop.md against all seven required changes in review 1, and read the D26, D90 and CHANGELOG diffs. The revision does what the request asks. Jev now only answers typed choice or yes/no questions, and a language model writes the prose. D90 says the same. R2 is labelled a counter-example and R1 is marked closed by D89. The loop is marked unproved, and nothing gets built unless records show at least N distinct jobs. A new section documents POST /v1/evaluate, and the two signals, top probability and confidence, are each defined with the decision they control. The doc chooses an explicit second call over the gateway fallback and stores the answering model in evidence. The reader budget, the single counted unit and the render() measurement gate are done. The promotion test size is computed (about 35 records) and the interval is dropped if data falls short. D26 and the RM-3 citation are fixed. Introspection is now a first-class step with every requested field. Athena code outside the agent snapshot reads past records, and the doc lists exactly what passes to the agent and onward. All seven operator cases are marked reported, each with a class and a prevention. Only three files changed: two markdown files under docs/ and CHANGELOG.md. `cargo test --locked -q` passes. I found nothing worse than nits.
